fest camp

fest validate tasks

Validate task files exist (CRITICAL)

Synopsis

Validate that implementation sequences have TASK FILES.

THIS IS THE MOST COMMON MISTAKE: Creating sequences with only SEQUENCE_GOAL.md but no task files.

Goals define WHAT to achieve. Tasks define HOW to execute.

AI agents EXECUTE TASK FILES. Without them, agents know the objective but don't know what specific work to perform.

CORRECT STRUCTURE: 02_api/ ├── SEQUENCE_GOAL.md ← Defines objective ├── 01_design_endpoints.md ← Task: design work ├── 02_implement_crud.md ← Task: implementation └── 03_testing_and_verify.md ← Quality gate

INCORRECT STRUCTURE (common mistake): 02_api/ └── SEQUENCE_GOAL.md ← No task files!

fest validate tasks [festival-path] [flags]
